title: Get to know System: Users, Roles and Permissions
summary: Tour of Users, Roles and Permissions: what each screen is for.

steps.title: System
steps.details: We'll go through Users, Roles and Permissions.

steps.title: Users
steps.details: Every user with access (staff and doctors), their roles and their status. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Roles
steps.details: A role groups permissions (Receptionist, Administrator, Doctor…). Each user gets one or more roles. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Permissions
steps.details: Each permission enables a screen or an action; they're assigned to roles. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
